name: Greek Sheet-Pan Chicken with Vegetables and Feta

components.name: Chicken, Vegetables & Feta

ingredients.name: Extra virgin olive oil, UNHANGRY reduced amount

steps: Heat oven to 220 C. Stir together olive oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss sliced vegetables in half the dressing. Coat the raw chicken in the other half and arrange everything in a single layer on two trays as needed.
Roast 25-35 minutes, checking chicken is 74 C, then add feta and olives for the last 5 minutes to warm without drying.
Divide cooked grain, chicken and roasted vegetables into six containers. Keep any extra fresh garnish separate.

components.name: Couscous
steps: Cook the dry grain separately with measured water according to package instructions, then fluff and fold in parsley.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Inspired by source sheet-pan meal; added measured grain and used lower oil amount, so source macros are not applicable.
Planning: Secondary method stovetop for grain. Correct cooking time for chosen grain per packet; dry bulgur has different nutrient profile from rice.
Freezer: freeze chicken and grain; roasted zucchini and feta lose texture
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
